retrievalProfile.description: A lifestyle portrait featuring vertical side-aligned text and a top-corner monogram, ideal for modern country or folk music branding.
excludeWhen: the subject is centered and looking at the camera
studio lighting is preferred over natural light

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a smiling man in a navy bomber jacket and baseball cap, positioned slightly off-center against a blurred forest background. The composition is defined by a strong vertical text block on the left and a circular monogram in the upper right.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical text block balances the subject's forward-leaning posture
Monogram in the top right acts as a secondary anchor to the left-side text
Yellow accents in the jacket trim echo the gold tones in the typography
Shallow depth of field separates the subject from the dense greenery
coreInvariants: Vertical text orientation on the left margin
Subject looking down and away from the camera
Navy and gold color palette against forest greens

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, subject occupies the center and right-center of the frame, leaning slightly left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the vertical text block on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the vertical text, moves across the subject's smile, and rests on the top-right monogram.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blurred forest background provides textured negative space that doesn't distract from the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Forest green and navy blue (background and clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, natural saturation in the background with high-value highlights on the text.

letterConstructionRules: Vertical orientation with characters rotated 90 degrees clockwise

treatment.fill: white and gold gradient or solid

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, condensed sans-serif for the name paired with a geometric, outlined monogram for branding.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold, and clean uppercase aesthetic.
Provides a similar industrial and modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man in a navy blue bomber jacket with yellow-striped cuffs and a grey baseball cap, smiling and looking down. The setting is a lush, out-of-focus forest path with natural sunlight filtering through the trees.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical uppercase text along the left margin using a bold condensed sans-serif. Place a circular outline monogram in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the text oriented vertically on the left?
Is the subject looking down and smiling?
Is there a monogram in the top right?
Does the color palette include navy, gold, and green?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the hat

mustAchieve: Soft, natural bokeh in the background
Balanced composition between text and subject

postGenerationChecks: Text is perfectly vertical and aligned to the left edge
The monogram does not overlap the subject's head
The subject's expression is candid and warm
The yellow accents in the jacket match the gold text
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Vertical Side Text + Corner Monogram + Natural Bokeh
